evals.prompt:
Write a complete engineering implementation guide for a Python standard-library local coding-agent task runner. This is a long-form technical deliverable, not an outline or summary. Provide all 24 chapters listed below, in order, as Markdown headings exactly `## CHAPTER <slug>`. Each chapter must contain at least 400 words of concrete discussion AND one distinct, substantive executable Python example of at least 20 lines. Keep the architecture consistent across chapters. Cover invariants, error handling, and a worked example in each chapter. Avoid filler, repeated paragraphs, placeholders, ellipses and unrelated topics. Do not shorten later chapters. Explain scheduling, dependencies, cancellation, persistence and tool execution coherently. This may take around 20000-30000 output tokens; the response budget is large enough. Do not ask to continue in another reply. End only after every chapter with the exact final line GUIDE-COMPLETE-24.

Chapters:
requirements-and-contracts
workspace-layout
lexer
parser
expression-evaluator
type-validation
dependency-graph
cycle-detection
scheduler
retry-policy
cancellation
event-journal
atomic-storage
checkpoint-recovery
resource-limits
tool-protocol
http-interface
cli-interface
observability
security-boundaries
unit-testing
integration-testing
load-testing
operations-and-examples
